title: Canonical raw presheaf colimit presentation at a represented object
statement: Let J, F, P, V, Q, i, G, theta, B, beta, U, D and E satisfy the category, continuity, object/arrow colimit, Kan-extension, unit and transition hypotheses of the raw-section setup [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Thus theta preserves the pullback units, beta exhibits each B_t as the raw left Kan extension of A_t, beta is compatible with B transitions, and E identifies D transitions with theta at transported U. Set Y=V_i(U) and Y_t=V_t(F(t.hom)(U)). There exist a colimit cocone R of D and an isomorphism q:R.pt -> (colimit B)(Y) such that for every t there is an equality e:Y_t=Y and R.ι_t q = E_t beta_t(F(t.hom)(U)) (colimit.ι B t)(Y_t) eqToHom((colimit B)(e)). In particular q is compatible with the canonical generator maps, not an arbitrary isomorphism. No presheaf T, map gamma or maps a are assumed.

proof.text: Use the cocone object equalities to form canonical maps D_t -> (colimit B)(V_i U). The beta and E transition equations make these maps a cocone, inducing mu from colimit D.

proof.text: Present B_t(V_i U) by the pointwise Kan formula. Lift each generator arrow and its endpoints to a common later stage using jointly surjective filtered object/arrow colimits and eventual equality. Transport its section by theta, restrict along the lifted arrow and use E inverse to obtain a colimit D class. Eventual equality of lifts, naturality, hbeta_map and hm respect the finite Kan and outer-colimit relations, giving psi.

proof.text: Check psi mu on a D generator using the identity lift; check mu psi on a Kan generator using naturality and the beta transition equation. Joint surjectivity extends the inverse equations to all elements. Use the chosen colimit cocone as R and the resulting isomorphism mu as q; its defining coprojection equation gives the compatibility formula.

theorem raw_section_presentation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ Type u)
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅ ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hm : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) :
    ∃ (R : Cocone D)
      (q : R.pt ≅ (colimit B).obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))),
      Nonempty (IsColimit R) ∧
      ∀ t : Under i,
        ∃ e : (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U) =
            (V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U,
          R.ι.app t ≫ q.hom =
            (E t).hom ≫ (β t).app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) ≫
              (colimit.ι B t).app
                (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun X => (colimit B).obj (op X)) e)
